item.title: Soulja Boy Requests DNA Test for Son With Ex Jackilyn Martinez
item.description:
Here's a short, engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Upbeat music fades out]
Host: "Welcome back to Trending on Billboard! Today, we're talking about Soulja Boy, the rapper who's been making headlines for his music and now, his personal life. You might remember him from his hit song 'Crank That' back in 2007, but now he's making news for a very different reason."
[Short music transition]
Host: "According to California court documents, Soulja Boy is questioning whether he's the father of a 3-year-old boy named KeAndre Way. He's filed for a DNA test to confirm paternity. If the test comes back positive, he's agreed to cover pregnancy costs and pay for his ex-partner Jackilyn Martinez's legal fees."
[Short pause]
Host: "This comes after Martinez filed a lawsuit against Soulja Boy in October 2025, seeking primary custody of the child and child support. She claims she's been covering most of the baby's expenses, and Soulja Boy only started contributing after she asked him to."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Soulja Boy's music career is still going strong, by the way. He just released his DRIP project in May, and he's had 10 Billboard Hot 100 entries, including that iconic No. 1 hit 'Crank That'. We'll be keeping an eye on this story and seeing how it unfolds. Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard!"
[Outro music starts playing]
